images.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: painted cloud-bank texture for a cliffside canyon. Generate ONE image, exactly 1536×1024 pixels.
Image 1 is a STYLE-ONLY reference: match its painted CLOUD rendering, palette and brushwork, never its layout or other objects.
Paint an entirely filled, edge-to-edge dense OPAQUE bank of billowing valley cumulus seen from above at a high three-quarter angle. Warm SUNSET key light from SCREEN UPPER-LEFT: rose-peach and warm cream on lit billow tops, soft lavender and dusky violet in valleys between billows, a few thin wisps. Hand-drawn painted 2D game environment, soft but readable painted cloud forms, clean material planes, restrained surface texture, bold jewel tones, no photographic texture or conspicuous grain.
Clouds cover 100 percent of every edge and every corner. No sky, ground, rocks, trees, bridge, horizon, empty gaps or transparency. No green plate: this task is a fully opaque cloud texture. Roughly uniform billow scale across the entire frame: each head about 120–260 pixels wide, no single dominant feature. Even overall brightness from top to bottom, no vignette or dark gradient. No characters, text, UI or border.
CRITICAL HORIZONTAL WRAP: LEFT and RIGHT edges must tile seamlessly. Design as one horizontally repeating cloud field with period exactly the image width; each billow cut off at the left continues at the right at the identical vertical position with matching silhouette, color, shading and local brightness. No visible join when copies are placed side by side. Do not add a border or flatten the edge strips.
RETRY — correct horizontal wrap continuity. Image 2 is the first cloud candidate, an EDIT TARGET. Keep its full opaque cloud coverage, palette, painted style and even overall brightness. Its left/right edge cloud contours and colors do not match at several heights. Repaint the cloud arrangement so EVERY cloud intersecting the right edge continues directly from the left edge at the same y coordinate. Especially align the lit and shadow regions at y=200–400 and y=500–850. Treat the canvas as a horizontal cylinder unwrapped: truly continuous billow forms across the join, not merely similar colors or duplicated edge strips. Output only the corrected single 1536×1024 cloud texture.

references.role: Style only: approved painted cliff and cloud look
Edit target: first generated cloud candidate

retries.reason: First candidate visibly mismatched cloud contours and colors across the left/right edges.
retries.change: Requested a targeted horizontal-wrap correction using the first candidate as an edit target.

concerns: Horizontal edge continuity remains visibly imperfect after the permitted retry.
Delivered PNG is confirmed 1536×1024 with no alpha channel and visually complete cloud coverage.
